propositions: The completion verifier returns non-deterministic verdicts (PASS vs FAIL) for identical inputs within minutes with no intervening code changes, making the close gate unreliable in both false-PASS (spurious pass of incomplete work) and false-FAIL (spurious block of complete work) directions.

The verifier's test-existence judgment is non-deterministic because the agent uses variable free-form searches (semantic/regex queries that fail, alongside literal substring queries that succeed) rather than deterministic literal-substring or structured symbol enumeration, causing borderline 'test not found' vs 'test found' to flip across runs.

The COMPLETION_VERDICT sidecar payload does not record verified_at_sha, trace_id, or input snapshot identity, making it impossible to distinguish non-determinism from input drift using stored data alone.

The verifier needs deterministic decoding (temperature pinned to 0.0 by default) and recorded verification metadata (verified_at_sha, trace_id) to make non-deterministic behavior observable and debuggable from persisted records.
